scope.description: Exact Dream Photonics dossier refresh across official, technical, registry, government-program, partner, accelerator and bilingual evidence lanes.

source.title: 2026 New Ventures BC Competition Top 10 finalists
source.summary: New Ventures BC named Dream Photonics among ten 2026 competition finalists and scheduled winners for September 21; finalist status is not a prize or technical validation.

leads.evidenceLocator: Official product pages and PDFs; AIM library; OFC 2026; PacifiCan and NRC agreements; FABrIC; ISC T11-21914; New Ventures BC; BC registry
followUpQuestions: Which PICTOR and photonic-packaging steps are operating in British Columbia today, and which remain pilot-line milestones?
Which device configurations, samples and acceptance criteria support the published microlens environmental and optical-performance claims?
Which foundry libraries, packaging services and licences can a Canadian buyer use now, and under what commercial terms?
What evidence would convert proposal T11-21914 from available-for-testing status into a completed government test or procurement result?
reviewWarnings: This is a fresh replacement candidate. Its organization and child baselines were read from production after the earlier malformed candidate was returned to research; review this packet as a new decision.
Current beneficial ownership, equity, employee count and Canadian-control details are not public; UBC spin-off status is not evidence of UBC ownership.
British Columbia records legal incorporation in 2019 while a UBC report says founded in 2020; founded_year remains null pending a resolved convention.
PacifiCan and the August 2026 profile support a pilot-line buildout, not an operating qualified-volume line, yield, throughput, customer acceptance or completed delivery.

Dream's microlens page cites environmental stress tests while the August 2026 profile frames Telcordia reliability as a future milestone; do not state formal qualification without configuration-specific evidence.
No reviewed public source establishes a Canadian or allied defence contract, completed government test, delivery, acceptance, operational fielding, procurement eligibility or classified use.
Company-reported customer counts and logos do not disclose scope, dates, contract value, delivery, acceptance or business unit and are not used as customer proof.
Federal and FABrIC agreement values fund defined work but do not establish full disbursement, completion, performance, commercialization, revenue or successful outcomes.
Public sources do not establish how assets, IP, staff, production steps or revenue are divided between Vancouver and Woodinville operations.
Published optical and environmental values combine first-party specifications and laboratory demonstrations; they are not represented as production guarantees.

recoveryAttempts.outcome: Confirmed the official identity, co-founders, Vancouver and Woodinville operating locations, product families, public contacts and company-stated milestones while separating spin-off status from current ownership.
Recovered a priced FaML test-station offer plus exact optical, environmental and integration specifications, then checked OFC and partner records for independent technical corroboration.
Confirmed British Columbia incorporation as Dream Photonics Inc. in December 2019 but found no current ownership, equity, control or good-standing disclosure.
Confirmed the PICTOR trademark application is live and awaiting examination; patent and trademark searches did not establish granted rights, five public families or technical performance.
Resolved five material NRC and PacifiCan agreements by business number with exact dates, values and purposes, preserving award, disbursement and outcome boundaries.
Found proposal T11-21914 available for testing, while exact CanadaBuys, DND and DRDC searches produced no Dream Photonics contract, completed test, delivery, acceptance or deployment.
Confirmed partner-hosted availability of the Dream component library and Applied Nanotools integration options without inferring customer uptake, defence use or volume production.
Recovered the August 25 Top 10 selection and PICTOR pilot-transition profile, treating company-supplied financing, revenue, customer and patent figures as unverified.
Checked French federal and FABrIC surfaces; they corroborated the same program families and produced no separate Quebec or francophone customer, contract or deployment evidence.

Final technical-paper, customer, qualification, defence and production searches found laboratory demonstrations but no named defence customer, production yield, formal qualification or in-service outcome.

leads.publicSummary: Dream Photonics is proposed to separate PICTOR adaptive optical packaging from silicon-photonics PDK/component IP, add bounded government and ecosystem programs, and surface the exact evidence needed for a Canadian production or qualification conversation.
leads.refreshSummary: Dream Photonics is proposed to update its organization profile and current activity; revise the existing hybrid-integration capability; add a PDK/component-IP capability; and add bounded New Ventures BC, ISC, FABrIC, NRC program and funding records. No Mission Area or Public Need relationship is currently published, and none is proposed.
intendedChanges: Update disclosed financing, public contact, current activity, operating context, Canadian footprint, executive relevance and reviewed questions.
Refine the existing capability as PICTOR adaptive micro-optics and hybrid integration with supported specifications and maturity limits.
Add silicon-photonics PDK and component IP as a distinct current capability.
Add New Ventures BC, ISC, FABrIC, NRC CSTIP and H3Lo-QP program participations.
Add five separately bounded PacifiCan and NRC funding events.
